requirement: Consider consensus and Smart Money for moneyline, spread and total decisions and show agreement or disagreement in every market write-up.
source: DraftKings publicly rendered betting splits table; actual schedule identity required
collection: Two public pages during existing due market captures; existing quotes API is separate
eligibility: Observed before kickoff and no later than decision time; stale, missing, wrong-opponent, wrong-kickoff or invalid shares cannot be applied.
promotion_policy: Existing factor governance: prospectively frozen core-versus-factor paired evidence, correlation review and approved exact-sample review before numeric promotion. No invented coefficients or retroactive pregame backfill.
